title: GallMine: an integrated knowledgebase and data repository on gallbladder cancer.
snippet: Gallbladder cancer (GBC) is a rare but aggressive hepatobiliary malignancy associated with high mortality rates. It has multi-factorial etiology with a poor diagnosis and prognosis.
